svg.title: A nurse is planning discharge teaching goals for a client starting warfarin. Which outcomes should the nurse include?
svg.desc: The correct outcomes require the client to name, demonstrate, or state something specific by a deadline, which the nurse can verify. Reviewing the medication list is a nursing action, and an INR of 1.0 would mean the client is not anticoagulated at all, so it is the wrong target entirely.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Anticoagulant Discharge Goals
Read the situation
A nurse is planning discharge teaching
goals for a client starting warfarin.
Which outcomes should the nurse include?
What fits here
The client will name three foods high in
vitamin K before discharge · The client
will demonstrate the use of an electric
razor before discharge · The client will
state two signs of…
Why it fits
The correct outcomes require the client to
name, demonstrate, or state something
specific by a deadline, which the nurse
can verify. Reviewing the medication list
is a nursing action, and an INR of 1.0
would mean the client is not
anticoagulated at all, so it is the wrong
target entirely.
